# Khronos Vulkan headers

`vulkan/vulkan_core.h` (header version 361, SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0 OR MIT; VXRuntime uses it under
the MIT license) and `vk_video/*.h` (the video codec headers it includes, SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0) are
the Khronos Group's Vulkan API headers, Copyright 2015-2026 The Khronos Group Inc., generated from the Vulkan XML
registry and used unchanged for the exact layout of every Vulkan structure and enumerant (THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md).
`vulkan/vk_platform.h` is VXRuntime's own: the Windows calling convention for this macOS process.
